show a negative balance in normal type

failover.tests: never fall back; a failure invalidates the call with the exact reason (decision.2026-10-20.no-midcall-swaps)
failover.call_start: router checks provider health and quota; a red component routes the whole call to the tenant's declared alternate stack (heard and approved); filed under the combination that ran
failover.mid_call: only a pre-declared same-voice, same-model fallback in another deployment or region (e.g. gpt-4.1-mini deployment A to B); else a graceful close shape and one callback inside window and budget; not billed
failover.carrier: two declared carriers per tenant, each with its own A2P-declared CLI; auto-switch for new attempts only if pre-approved (A3), else pause + card; trigger 10%+ dial failures in 15 min on 20+ dials (intelligence M07)
failover.resume: paused_by=provider_outage auto-resumes after 10 min green inside window (campaigns module); dials that never reached answer are re-queued without budget charge; answered calls cut by VP get one callback and are not billed

capacity.tpm_per_concurrent_call: 13-25k (M, l8 round2: 50k-TPM deployment returned 429 on 13/35 turns at 3 concurrent speculative streams)
capacity.admission: dialer reserves provider quota per call (token bucket) before dialing; no reservation, no dial
capacity.lanes: hot (live calls) vs background (analysis, learning, Operator) with background capped at 30% of shared deployments and paused after a hot 429 (asset.tx-core.quota-lanes-hot-vs-background-tpm-isolation)
capacity.scale_to_zero: never for live media; workers and Scout may scale to zero and wake before signing (HV law 30)
